content.heading: Care is a technical skill.
content.description:
I’m Alex, an engineer who enjoys the space between a thoughtful design and a dependable system. I ask what people are trying to do before deciding what to build.

Away from the screen, I’m usually finding a new walking route, making coffee, or learning how something works.
